required_fixes.description: The boilerplate_resistance_real_corpus metric (resistance_score = 1.0 - abs(correlation)) is uninformative for collapsed representations. citation_blended_debiased scores 0.988 resistance despite being completely collapsed (all similarities = 1.0). A minimum embedding variance threshold should gate this metric.
required_fixes.repair: Add variance gate: if embedding variance < threshold, mark resistance as DEGENERATE rather than computing a score.

claim_ceiling: Cycles 10+11 complete. 15 benchmarks established (13 prior + cross_language_pairs, boilerplate_resistance_real_corpus). citation-heritage benchmark VALIDATED: discrimination between real (AUC 0.64-0.68) and random (0.52). citation_blended remains BEST representation (AUC 0.680, zero dead zones). CRITICAL NEGATIVE: naive PCA debiasing on 64-dim citation_blended COLLAPSES the representation (AUC 0.493, all similarities = 1.0). Root cause: removing 2 PCA components from 64 dims deletes ~34% variance. Cross-language benchmark validates: citation patterns are language-correlated (cross-lang sim = -0.163 for blended). All original representations PASS boilerplate resistance on real corpus (>0.5). language_debiased_pca2 has BEST resistance (0.916). Honest negative result: no existing combination strategy achieves both low language dominance AND high citation heritage AUC. Product needs debiasing+citation combined at representation learning stage, not post-hoc PCA.
